Medical History

- Current health issues and chronic disease risk factors (e.g., hypertension, diabetes):
  • Acute unilateral throbbing headache (left-sided) with photophobia; no prior history of headaches.  
  • Possible migraine episode.  
  • No known chronic diseases reported.  
- Family history of chronic conditions (e.g., CVD, diabetes):
  • Mother: hypertension; history of migraines.  
  • No other family history recorded.  
- Current medications including OTC and traditional medicines:
  • Microgynon combined oral contraceptive pill – dose/route/frequency not documented (daily per typical use).  
  • Paracetamol – dose/route/frequency not documented (taken for current headache).  
  • Occasional NSAID use in the past; none taken in last few days.  
- Immunisation status reviewed (flu, COVID-19, pneumococcal, shingles, tetanus):
  • Not recorded.  
- Sexual/reproductive health status and risks:
  • Uses combined oral contraceptive pill (started ~6 years ago).  
  • Last menstrual period ≈1 week ago; no cycle-related headache pattern identified.  
  • No discussion of STI screening, pregnancy planning, or cervical screening.  
- Lifestyle: physical activity, diet, tobacco, alcohol, substance use:
  • Alcohol: “a few drinks at the weekend.”  
  • Tobacco: non-smoker.  
  • Illicit drugs: denies use.  
  • Physical activity and diet: not recorded.  
- Hearing and vision concerns:
  • No visual disturbance; photophobia present with current headache.  
  • Hearing concerns not discussed.  
- Mood, mental health, and risk assessment (depression, anxiety, self-harm):
  • Reports being “a bit stressed at work.”  
  • No screening for mood disorder or self-harm.  
- Social context: family support, caregiving, housing, financial stressors:
  • Lives with housemates/friends.  
  • Employed; work-related stress noted.  
  • No other social or financial issues documented.  

Examination

- Vital signs: BP, pulse rate and rhythm: Not recorded (telehealth).  
- Anthropometry: height, weight, BMI, waist circumference if indicated: Not recorded.  
- Oral health: gums, teeth, dentures if relevant: Not recorded.  
- Ear exam including otoscopy: Not performed.  
- Eye exam: visual acuity, pupil response, fundus if indicated: Not performed.  
- Urinalysis: dipstick for protein, glucose, ketones, blood: Not performed.  

Investigations (as indicated)

- No investigations ordered during this consultation.  

Health Promotion & Planning

- Education on chronic disease prevention and lifestyle modification:
  • Advised adequate hydration.  
  • Discussed safe use of combined paracetamol and NSAID for acute headache.  
- Discuss patient health goals and priorities:
  • Primary goal: relief of current headache.  
- Assess eligibility for GP Management Plan (GPMP) or Team Care Arrangements (TCA):
  • Not discussed; no chronic disease identified.  
- Referral to allied health, Quitline, AOD services, Aboriginal health worker, or social supports:
  • Not indicated at this time.  
- Schedule follow-up and recall appointments as needed:
  • Advised to have blood pressure checked “if not done recently.”  
  • Instructed to seek urgent review if headache worsens, new symptoms develop (fever, rash), or persistence despite therapy.  

Consider

- Mental health support or counselling referral if work stress persists or mood symptoms emerge.  
- Specialist referral (neurology) if headaches recur or do not respond to simple analgesia.  
- Optometry referral if visual symptoms develop.  
- Audiometry referral if hearing issues emerge.  
- Social work support if social determinants of health become a concern.  

Quality checks (always include at bottom of note):

● Missing but clinically expected elements: vital signs, BMI, immunisation history, cardiovascular risk screening, urinalysis, chronic disease blood tests.  
● Internal conflicts or contradictions: none noted.  
● Transcript quality notes: Telehealth encounter; no physical examination possible; patient demographic details incomplete in transcript (name, full address not captured).
